purpose: Every MCP tool name Truvio.Commerce.MCP 0.6.6 registers, generated from a tools/list capture (never edited by hand). scripts/validate_recipes.py accepts a recipe binding that names a tool of any supported version; the runner checks each binding against the target's own tools/list and falls to the next binding, so a recipe that binds a 0.6.6 tool keeps a fallback for an older server. Names 0.6.0 registered that this capture does not list are under notRegisteredOn066.

mcp-0.6.6-tools-list.note: tools/list on /admin/mcp of a scratch site whose MCP configuration lists every tool of the add-in except the grant-gated migration class, captured 2026-11-19 after the add-in was rolled from 0.6.3-BETA (680 tools) to 0.6.6-BETA. Added since 0.6.3 among others: save_product_asset_categories, delete_product_asset_categories, save_order_flows, update_order_states, save_product_group_fields, upload_file_from_url. Removed since 0.6.3: assign_data_model_to_products_and_groups.

notRegisteredOn066.note: registered in the 0.6.0 file and absent from the 0.6.6 capture: assign_data_model_to_products_and_groups was removed from the add-in after 0.6.3 (its 0.6.3 capture still lists it); the others are the migration and site-extraction tools the 0.6.0 file lists under not-on-endpoint (grant-gated), not measured here.
